invariants: Factory Credit is an execution/resource estimate and must not be converted directly into a customer price
Pricing intelligence is internal decision support only and cannot publish or activate a customer quotation
Customer price requires separate human commercial approval
Insufficient historical evidence must not produce a high-confidence recommendation
Stale or incomplete cost evidence returns REVIEW or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
Approved scope snapshot is required before producing a scope-specific price range
Internal AI/build failures, regressions and implementation mistakes must inform cost learning but are not automatically billable to the customer
Third-party recurring costs must be separated from one-time implementation price where applicable
Capacity pressure may inform scheduling or contingency review but must not silently increase customer price
Price range is advisory and must not overwrite an existing approved quotation
